<function name="SetSizeX" parent="DSizeToContents" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Sets whether the <page>DSizeToContents</page> panel should size to contents horizontally. This is `true` by default.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="sizeX" type="boolean">Whether the panel should size to contents horizontally.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
